# Tom Fabre

> Tom Fabre is a product and brand designer based in Madrid and co-founder of Binōme Studio. He designs brands, websites and digital products (branding, web design, UX/UI, strategy) with more than ten years of experience between Latin America and Europe. He works in Spanish, French and English and is available for new projects.

The portfolio has real URLs per language: Spanish at the root, English under /en/ and French under /fr/. Each project below links to its detail page. Full text of every project in all three languages is in llms-full.txt; structured data is in portfolio.json.

## About

- [Bio](https://tomfabre.com/en/bio/): Background, way of working, quick facts and personal links.
- [Contact](https://tomfabre.com/en/contact/): Email hey@tomfabre.com, contact form and profile links.
- [CV (PDF)](https://tomfabre.com/cv-alvaro-fabre.pdf): Curriculum vitae.

## Projects

- [Contazara](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/contazara/): Branding · Web · Digital. Rebranding, website and digital communications for a company with 40 years of history, shaped together with its team.
- [À2pas](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/a2pas/): Product Design · UX/UI · Branding. A participatory platform connecting audiences, artists and venues to make new performances possible.
- [HappyLife](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/happylife/): Product Design · UX/UI. An app bringing people together through real activities, with fewer taps, smarter filters and rewards for taking part.
- [Binōme Studio](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/binome/): Branding · Strategy · Web. An independent studio built on combining experience, ideas and different skills to create thoughtful work.
- [Yaypegs](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/yaypegs/): Art Direction · Motion Design. A universe of digital characters where the challenge was bringing thousands of combinations to life while keeping visual consistency.
- [360estudio](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/360estudio/): Branding · Web design · Art direction. Creating a visual and digital experience that gives the studio's projects room to shine while expressing its distinctive personality.
- [Mobile Experiences](https://tomfabre.com/en/projects/mobile-experiences/): Product Design · UX/UI · Mobile. Three apps. Three challenges. Far more than screens.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://tomfabre.com/en/services/): Three ways to move a good idea forward.
- [Branding & identity](https://tomfabre.com/en/services/branding/): A brand with something to say. I build and evolve brand identities that help businesses become recognizable, stand apart and connect with the right people.
- [Web design & development](https://tomfabre.com/en/services/web-design/): A good website should do more than look good. I design and build websites that communicate clearly, work smoothly and help turn visits into opportunities.
- [Digital product, UX/UI & digital strategy](https://tomfabre.com/en/services/ux-ui-design/): Less friction. More purpose. I design and improve digital experiences so they're intuitive, useful and easy to navigate, without losing sight of business goals.
